mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce discount rates for equity cash flows and stimulate economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines (i.e., returns are negative in >60% of triggered cases).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% over the past month predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as labor market deterioration signals weakening consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE rises above 4.5% (i.e., returns are positive in >60% of triggered cases).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 and an increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.3% predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as combined supply and labor market weakness signals economic contraction and reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: The combined signal fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of triggered instances (i.e., SPX returns are positive in >50% of cases when both conditions are met).

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), a monthly increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 0.2% predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as persistent inflation triggers further rate hikes that pressure equity valuations.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), the signal fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases (i.e., returns are positive in >50% of triggered instances).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as stronger housing activity indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when HOUST rises (i.e., returns are negative in >60% of triggered cases).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 150.0 thousand persons predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as strong job growth supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS rises above 150.0 thousand.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent monthly increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.5% and housing starts (HOUST) above 0.3% predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as robust consumer spending across multiple sectors indicates sustained economic momentum and positive earnings outlooks.
failure_condition: The combined signal fails to predict positive returns in more than 50% of triggered instances (i.e., SPX returns are negative in >50% of cases when both conditions are met).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as reduced manufacturing output signals economic contraction and lower corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO falls below 105.0 (i.e., returns are positive in >60% of triggered cases).
